text: The plaintiffs’ lawyers filed motions in limine citing nine cases, eight of which did not exist. The court recounted that Rudwin Ayala uploaded his draft to MX2.law to add case law and failed to verify the resulting citations. The court described the site as apparently an in-house Morgan & Morgan database and credited counsel’s account of the platform used.
asserted_by: asserting party not identified in the indexed source fields
canonical_source_conflicted: Actual case law and court record
mitigation_gap: AI-generated legal citations were not verified against source materials before filing.
reliance_or_harm: The plaintiffs withdrew the motions. The court sanctioned the three signing attorneys and declined to order their firms to show cause at that time.
source_review_unresolved: Payment, subsequent proceedings, compliance and the underlying model used by MX2.law were not verified.
